pages.headline: On-the-Fly Machine Learning Force Field Generation via Bayesian Active Learning
pages.subheadline: Accelerating Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics by ~1000×
body_points: Automated training during MD simulations via Bayesian inference
Integrated with VASP electronic-structure code
Quantitative accuracy for melting points of Al, Si, Ge, Sn, and MgO
pages.visual_hints: Cinematic wide shot of molecular dynamics trajectory as luminous particles streaming through dark void, crystalline lattice structures of Al and MgO floating in foreground with holographic Bayesian uncertainty clouds glowing gold, title text integrated as neon signage with electric cyan accents, dramatic rim lighting, 16:9 aspect ratio

pages.headline: The Computational Bottleneck in Ab Initio MD
pages.subheadline: First-principles calculations limit accessible timescales and system sizes
body_points: Direct FP-MD requires thousands of density functional theory calculations
Cubic scaling with system size restricts simulations to ~100 atoms
Phase transitions and melting phenomena demand extensive statistical sampling
pages.visual_hints: Split-screen composition: left side shows dark crowded supercomputer server room with red warning lights representing computational cost, right side shows elegant but small atomic cluster simulation in blue glow, large hourglass with sand nearly empty between them representing time constraint, funnel visualization showing bottleneck, cinematic color grading with deep blues and warning reds
facts_to_preserve: Thousands of DFT calculations required for MD

pages.headline: Bayesian Active Learning Workflow
pages.subheadline: Uncertainty quantification guides automated data selection during MD
body_points: Gaussian Process predicts energies and forces with uncertainty estimates
Bayesian uncertainty threshold determines when to execute DFT calculations
New quantum data refines force field on-the-fly without human intervention
pages.visual_hints: Holographic flowchart floating in dark space, central glowing brain-like Bayesian network with probability distributions as orbiting particles, arrows showing feedback loop from MD trajectory back to training data, VASP logo integrated into the circuit, Gaussian bell curves glowing in gold and purple, neon pathways showing data flow, scientific instrument aesthetic with precision optics

pages.headline: Automated Force Field Generation
pages.subheadline: Seamless integration with molecular dynamics iterations
body_points: Each MD step triggers uncertainty evaluation within the VASP framework
First-principles calculation executed only for novel atomic configurations
Instant force field update maintains simulation continuity without interruption
pages.visual_hints: Temporal sequence visualization showing MD trajectory as luminous path through 3D configuration space, sparse bright red dots marking FP calculations among thousands of blue ML steps showing the 99% bypass, decision diamond with uncertainty check, crystal structures morphing from ordered solid to disordered liquid along the path, cinematic motion blur showing temporal evolution, dark background with glowing trajectory

pages.headline: Computational Acceleration
pages.subheadline: Three orders of magnitude speedup with maintained quantum accuracy
body_points: Direct FP-MD achieves ~1 step per minute for typical systems
MLFF-MD achieves ~1000 steps per minute with identical forces
Statistical properties including melting points quantitatively reproduced
pages.visual_hints: Bar chart visualization as architectural towers, left tower dark and short labeled FP-MD, right tower glowing gold and 1000x taller labeled MLFF-MD, large speedometer graphic showing needle pegged at maximum, lightning bolt motifs, particle swarm showing rapid motion blur on right side, mathematical equation '1000×' floating in space, dramatic lighting with sunbeams behind the tall tower

pages.headline: Melting Point Calculations
pages.subheadline: Phase transitions of Al, Si, Ge, Sn, and MgO validated against experiment
body_points: Solid-liquid coexistence simulations with ~1000 atoms per phase
Thermodynamic integration confirms quantitative FP accuracy
Calculated melting points match experimental values within 50K
pages.visual_hints: Split-screen showing ordered crystal lattice on left (blue, solid phase) and disordered liquid on right (red, liquid phase) with flat interface between them showing the solid-liquid coexistence, periodic table elements Al, Si, Ge, Sn, Mg, O highlighted, thermometer graphic showing convergence, heat waves rising from the liquid side, scientific precision with crystallographic detail

pages.headline: Thermodynamic Verification
pages.subheadline: Perturbation theory confirms quantitative reproduction of FP melting points
body_points: Free energy differences between MLFF and direct FP calculations vanish within statistical error
Bayesian uncertainty quantification validates model convergence
Quantitative accuracy achieved without empirical fitting parameters
pages.visual_hints: Mathematical equations floating in 3D space showing ΔG = G_MLFF - G_FP = 0, convergence graph with lines merging showing melting point validation over simulation time, shield or seal of approval motif glowing gold, mirror surface showing perfect reflection between MLFF and FP results, Bayesian probability distributions as translucent bell curves, scientific precision with mathematical rigor
facts_to_preserve: Quantitative reproduction of FP melting points

pages.headline: Enabling Large-Scale Quantum Simulations
pages.subheadline: Machine learning bridges accuracy and efficiency for materials discovery
body_points: Automated workflow eliminates manual force field development
Accessible to non-expert users through standard VASP interface
Pathway to nanosecond-scale ab initio dynamics for complex phase transitions
